name: dit_terminal_precision_campaign
hypothesis: Fixed-noise differentiable original four-step RF first-action supervision with train-only local action scale; frozen vision and complete DiT backbone
acceptance: independent MuJoCo postXYZ <=20um for 200 consecutive 50ms cycles; near four states then five standard targets each1600
launch: one real GNOME launch; no polling afterwards

architecture.freeze: vision.* frozen/eval, all nonvision parameters trainable
architecture.cache: full original FP32 visual tokens [2,49,384]; original _condition and _predict_velocity reused including all original OCT branches
architecture.sampler: original midpoint-in-time Euler RF four steps fixed_template_seed434341, K1,exec1

scales.OCT_valid_velocity_previous_accepted: original global buffers and original extra branches preserved
scales.action: train-only first-action population mean/std; fixed floors [1e-4deg,1e-4deg,1e-5mm]
scales.candidate2: new registered E40-E42 training only; previous E41 development retired, no independent holdout claim

training.precision: FP32 no autocast/TF32; intentional numerical parity and direct sampler gradient stability
training.loss: mean(((sample4step_first-accepted_same_tick)/train_action_std)^2) + 0.005 * original all16 rectified-flow MSE in same local output coordinates
training.checkpoint: every500 updates and finally, before metrics/report CPU/GPU operations
training.selection: final3000 actual updates, no dev checkpoint selection
training.engineering_failure: retain weights and failure; no science conclusion; all time charged

parity.original_sampler: all four intermediate states/velocities and final16 outputs,12real windows
parity.cache: full original online RGB2 vs cached tokens,12real windows; FP32 atol1e-6 rtol1e-5
parity.expanded_cache: one actual RGB2 window per real collection episode; compare original full sampler

near.gate: original50+-1um start, two actual prefix ticks,nonzero actual incoming velocity, valid RGB2
near.baseline: saved original neural_exec124_50um_v1 exec1 only, no rerun

expansion.condition: any near strict pass OR >=2/4 last200max reductions>=20% AND geometric mean ratio<=0.8
expansion.role: training only; E41 selected-development role retired after candidate1
expansion.RGB2: real continuous images,actual velocity,previous accepted,same-tick accepted label,16 horizon no padding
expansion.entry: 100um only after observed valid OCT 90..150um support>=4 windows on each training target; full original state/history preserved

standard.dependency: candidate2 all4 near strict pass and expansion coverage supports100um
standard.start: fresh production RCMSceneV9 constructor default, target set only; original first-cycle history warmup zero retained
standard.route: original v5 until valid observable OCT norm<=100um then fixed-noise near DiT, one-way no state/velocity/accepted/history reset
standard.strict: each all last200 independent postXYZ<=20um including final, all5 required

reporting.TEST_LOG: each test immediately append task and deployment root with locked fsync exact readback
